---
name: image-resizer
description: Resize images to a maximum width while keeping the aspect ratio.
---

# Image resizer

1. Install Pillow if needed: `pip install pillow==10.4.0`
2. Run `python scripts/resize.py <image> <max_width>`
3. The resized copy is saved as `<name>-<width>.<ext>` next to the original.
